hints.content: To find the image of $\triangle ABC$ under the dilation, we can dilate all of $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD C$ is $3$ units to the right of $P$ and $9$ units up, so its image is $\goldD{\dfrac13}\cdot3=1$ unit to the right and $\goldD{\dfrac13}\cdot 9=3$ units up from $P$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is nine units to the left of point P and six units up, Point C is three units right from point P and nine units up, and Point A is six units left of point P and three units down. There is a dashed line to highlight horizontally three units right point P. Another dashed line highlights horizontally one unit right and three units up. There is another plotted point that is one unit right from point P and three units up.

hints.content:
Let's do the same thing with the remaining vertices.

Since our scale factor is $\goldD{\dfrac13}$, every side length in $\triangle A'B'C'$ will be $\dfrac{1}{3}$ the length of the corresponding side in $\triangle ABC$.

Another way to think about it is that since our scale factor is closer to $0$ than to $1$, every point in the image will be closer to our center $P$ than to its corresponding point in the pre-image.

Connecting the vertices of the image, we get the following mapping:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is nine units to the left of point P and six units up, Point C is three units right from point P and nine units up, and Point A is six units left of point P and three units down. There is another triangle graphed that is triangle A B C with a scale factor of one third from point P. The new triangle the Point B prime is three units to the left of point P and two units up, Point C prime is one unit right from point P and three units up, and Point A prime is two units left of point P and one unit down. The distance between C prime and B prime is approximately four point one units. The distance between C prime and A prime is five units. The distance between A prime and B prime is three point two units.

question.content:
**Draw the image of $\triangle ABC$ under a dilation whose center is $P$ and scale factor is $\dfrac{1}{3}$.**
